pages.text: Use it on a creature at half its health or less: the body stays up as a $(l)host$(). With a jar in your off hand, you keep the $(l)head$().
$(l)Who Gives What$()$(br)Any jar takes a head, and the body falls.$(br)$(l)Head only$(), in a jar, which takes all of it: slime, magma cube, shulker, vex, bee, silverfish, endermite, tadpole.
pages.title: Form 4-S

pages.text: $(l)Big heads$(): a Reinforced Life Support Jar or bigger for a warden, elder guardian, hoglin, zoglin, sniffer or medium slime; an Executive one for a ghast, ravager or big slime.
pages.title: Form 4-S (2)

pages.text: $(l)Neither$(): the Dragon, the Wither, other bosses, babies, named creatures, other people's pets, hosts, armour stands.$(br)A refused cut costs nothing: no jar, no wear.
pages.title: Form 4-S (3)

pages.text: $(l)Snow golem$(): the first cut takes its pumpkin off. Saw again for the head.$(br2)$(l)Babies$(): come back when it is grown. A server may allow them.
